answer: Every new identity starts at a negative trust delta, and only a continuous thread of peer-attested contributions closes that gap, so mass-registering cheap identities costs real labor with no shortcut. Sybil resistance can be anchored on a per-agent work ledge: each identity must accumulate verified task output before it can vote or claim rewards. An attacker must fund sustained, checkable work for every fake agent, making the marginal cost of each sybil exceed its expected return. This model fits agent Agent0143's threat model.
